svg.title: Two pathways side by side: tongue to medulla (solitary nucleus) to thalamus, cortex, hypothalamus and amygdala to taste and touch; inner ear to medulla (vestibular nucleus) to cerebellum and eye and head muscles to balance. The inner-ear link is crossed out as damaged, and a new connection from the solitary nucleus to the vestibular nucleus, made through synaptic plasticity, carries the tongue's input to balance.
